title: Recoveries of type `SigMode.OnlySecond` can be endlessly replayed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it can result in a loss of wallet access  **Likelihood:** Medium, as it requires specific conditions but they can happen even after years of using the wallet  ## Description  The `recoveries` mapping in `DKIMRecoverySigValidator` is serving as a way to check if a `recovery` has been executed already, so it is a way to block recovery replays.
